wsp_reference.paper: Weight-Space Programming Doesn't Need Transformers (Hyunjong Ok & Jaeho Lee, EFFL Lab, POSTECH, 2026)
wsp_reference.static_ast_contract: All WSP forward(w, x) programs pass upstream wsp/free_model.py:static_problems == []

scope_and_disclosure.wsp_paradigm: Rule-programmed weights in weight space (params_learned = 0, training_examples = 0, Fit time = 'none'); grouped conceptually with Hand-set CRAM as zero-training rule-informed programs, never conflated with data-learned models (CRAM, Count Energy, EBR, TRM, etc.) that infer constraints from solved examples without supplied rule descriptions.
scope_and_disclosure.flops_convention: Paper FullCounter (FC2) arithmetic + transcendental FLOPs across all chains and all capped/unsolved instances; comparison-inclusive totals (total_with_compare) also recorded.
scope_and_disclosure.hardware_note: All local WSP timings and CRAM fresh timings measured on NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Max-Q Workstation Edition (Compute Capability 12.0) and AMD Ryzen Threadripper PRO 9985WX; published neural baseline wall times use H200.
